forbidden.help: Need this access for a project task? Talk to the coordination team — only they can change access profiles.

loadError.description: We could not reach the server right now. Check your connection and try again. Your link is still valid.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Talk to the project coordination team. They will generate a link for you to create a new password.
forgotPassword.notice: The link is valid for {{hours}} hours and can only be used once. Your password is never sent by email.

resetPassword.subtitle: Create a new password to sign in to TEDI.

success.title: Password reset!
success.description: All set. Sign in with your RA and your new password.

errors.unknown: Could not save the new password. Please try again.

empty.title: No members yet
empty.description: Generate a registration link and send it to the person. They show up here as soon as they finish signing up.

noResults.title: Nothing found
noResults.description: No member matches the search and the selected filters. Try another term or clear the filters.

error.title: Could not load the members
error.description: Check your connection and try again.

createInvite.title: Generate registration link
createInvite.description: Choose the role for the invited person.

errors.unknown: Could not generate the invite. Please try again.

generatedLink.copyFallback: Could not copy automatically. The link has been selected: use Ctrl+C (or Cmd+C) to copy it.

memberAccess.title: System access
memberAccess.ownAccount: You cannot change your own account

passwordReset.title: Password reset link
passwordReset.description: Generates a single-use link for the person to create a new password.
passwordReset.validity: Valid for {{hours}} hours and can only be used once. Send it to the person through a secure channel. The link is not shown again after you close this window.

disableAccess.title: Disable access
disableAccess.warning: The person can no longer sign in to the system. If they have TEDI open, they are signed out on their next action. The history of lessons, attendance and hours stays. To record the person leaving the project with a date, use Deactivate member.
disableAccess.note: You cannot disable your own account or the last active coordinator. Access can be re-enabled later in Edit member › System access.

pendingInvites.title: Pending invites ({{count}})
pendingInvites.description: Registration links that have been generated and have not been used or expired yet.
pendingInvites.caption: Invites waiting to be used
pendingInvites.notice: Revoking invalidates the link right away; anyone who opens it will see “This link is no longer valid”. Used or expired invites leave this list.
pendingInvites.error: Could not load the invites. Close and open this window again.

confirm.title: Revoke invite
confirm.body: {{role}} invite generated on {{date}}. The link stops working right away and cannot be restored.
